user_facing_goal: Using only the Hazard Weaver Agent wildfire inventory and tools, load sample sample_000 of dataset hw_wildfire_danger_tabular_v1, run a compatible danger predictor from the allowed model list, and report the predicted cause class id for this fire event. Write a short justification of which model you used and why it matches the sample schema.

sample_refs.notes: Tabular wildfire-danger features for one event.

hints: Prefer a tabular danger classifier registered in the wildfire agent pack.

success_criteria.description: Predicted cause class id matching the gold label for sample_000.

gold.eval_notes: Illustrative gold for schema freeze; real gold materializes in W2 from HW-owned samples.

provenance.bootstrap_note: Example only. Future samples/checkpoints may be bootstrapped offline; runtime ids are HW-owned.
